successors.name: Han dynasty
successors.text: Yelang, 'in what is now western Guizhou province', 'west of the Mimo and Dian, south of Qiongdu'; believed to cover parts of Guizhou, Hunan, Sichuan and Yunnan

ledger.x: 281: Yelang first dated in the record.
111: the kingdom of Yelang ends in Han's absorption; the Yi people 'may be modern descendants'.

wars.name: Han conquest of Nanyue and absorption of Yelang
wars.outcome: Yelang, a Nanyue vassal from 183 BC, was absorbed by Han in 111 BC when Han conquered Nanyue.

certainty.note: No Yelang boundary is on the page, and its extent is 'believed' to cover parts of four provinces.
